platformLimits.manifestAndModelStep: Raycast preferences are a static JSON manifest: the aiProvider dropdown can only list the curated built-ins (models.dev is fetched at runtime and cannot be declared there), and the dropdown's first item is the disabled-by-contract empty placeholder {title:'Select a provider', value:''} that ships as the default. The full catalogue provider + model picker is the 'choose-ai-provider' List command (provider list → pushed model List), whose pick is stored as a LocalStorage override. The model step is navigation.push inside that command, not a second manifest command.
platformLimits.note: Declared as a platform limit: manifest dropdown = empty placeholder + curated built-ins, List command = full catalogue + models.
